<script>document.body.setAttribute("data-page","about");document.body.classList.remove("dlk-site-system");</script>
<style data-site-css="about-journal.css">
.about-journal{--ink:#15352f;--muted:#596e67;--teal:#0c7f73;--mint:#d8ede4;--paper:#f7f7f1;--line:#d6ded7;--navy:#102c30;--font:var(--proto-font-sans);--serif:var(--proto-font-sans)}
.about-journal *{box-sizing:border-box}
.about-journal{scroll-behavior:smooth}
.about-journal{margin:0;color:var(--ink);font-family:var(--font);background:var(--paper)}
.about-journal button, .about-journal a{font:inherit}
.about-journal a{color:inherit;text-decoration:none}
.about-journal button{cursor:pointer}
.about-journal img{display:block;width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover}
.about-journal h1, .about-journal h2, .about-journal h3, .about-journal p, .about-journal blockquote{margin:0}
.about-journal p{line-height:1.7}
.about-journal .wrap{width:min(100% - 80px,var(--proto-container));margin:auto}
.about-journal .eyebrow, .about-journal .micro{font-size:11px;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:.17em;text-transform:uppercase}
.about-journal .eyebrow{color:var(--teal)}
.about-journal .section-head{max-width:710px}
.about-journal .section-head h2{font-size:clamp(37px,4vw,62px);line-height:1.07;letter-spacing:-.055em;margin:17px 0 20px;font-weight:700}
.about-journal .section-head p{font-size:17px;color:var(--muted);max-width:640px}
.about-journal .button{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:12px;background:var(--teal);color:#fff;padding:17px 23px;border:1px solid var(--teal);font-weight:800;font-size:13px;letter-spacing:.01em;transition:transform .2s,background .2s}
.about-journal .button:hover{transform:translateY(-2px);background:#09695f}
.about-journal .button.ghost{background:transparent;color:inherit;border-color:currentColor}
.about-journal .button.ghost:hover{background:rgba(255,255,255,.08)}
.about-journal .text-link{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;border-bottom:1px solid currentColor;padding:12px 0;font-size:13px;font-weight:800}
.about-journal .actions{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:center;gap:27px}
.about-journal .bullets{padding:0;margin:22px 0 0;list-style:none}
.about-journal .bullets li{padding:8px 0 8px 22px;position:relative;font-size:13px;line-height:1.5}
.about-journal .bullets li:before{content:'↗';position:absolute;left:0;color:var(--teal);font-weight:800}
.about-journal .specs{display:flex;gap:28px;margin:22px 0}
.about-journal .specs div{border-top:1px solid currentColor;padding-top:10px;min-width:130px}
.about-journal .specs dt{font-size:10px;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:.13em;text-transform:uppercase;opacity:.65}
.about-journal .specs dd{margin:5px 0 0;font-size:15px;font-weight:800}
.about-journal .site-header{height:76px;background:#fff;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(16,52,45,.1);position:relative;z-index:30}
.about-journal .header-inner{width:min(100% - 80px,var(--proto-container));height:100%;margin:auto;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:60px}
.about-journal .brand, .about-journal .site-footer strong{font-size:24px;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:-.1em;color:var(--ink)}
.about-journal .brand span, .about-journal .site-footer strong span{font-size:9px;vertical-align:top;letter-spacing:0}
.about-journal .site-header nav{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:30px;margin-left:auto}
.about-journal .site-header nav a{font-size:12px;color:#647771;font-weight:700}
.about-journal .site-header nav a.active{color:var(--teal);border-bottom:2px solid var(--teal);padding:29px 0 27px}
.about-journal .header-portal{font-size:12px;font-weight:800;background:#e5f2ec;color:var(--teal);padding:13px 17px}
.about-journal .header-portal span{margin-left:9px}
.about-journal .site-footer{background:#0b2426;color:#acc4bc;padding:31px 0 100px}
.about-journal .site-footer .wrap{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;gap:20px;font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.12em}
.about-journal .site-footer strong{color:#fff}
.about-journal .site-footer a{text-decoration:underline;text-underline-offset:4px}
.about-journal.variant-c{--paper:var(--proto-editorial-paper);--ink:var(--proto-neutral-800);--muted:#69746b;--teal:var(--proto-teal-600);background:var(--proto-editorial-paper)}
.about-journal.variant-c .site-header{background:var(--proto-editorial-paper)}
.about-journal.variant-c .header-portal{background:#e1e9dd}
.about-journal.variant-c .section-head h2{font-family:var(--serif);font-weight:400;letter-spacing:-.025em}
.about-journal .hero-c{padding:70px 0 65px;background:var(--proto-editorial-paper)}
.about-journal .c-hero-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.1fr .9fr;gap:5%;align-items:start}
.about-journal .c-hero-text{padding-top:15px}
.about-journal .c-hero-rule{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;border-top:1px solid #899a8d;padding-top:12px;margin:35px 0 17px;font-size:9px;letter-spacing:.14em;font-weight:800;color:#648073}
.about-journal .hero-c h1{font-family:var(--serif);font-weight:400;letter-spacing:-.04em;line-height:1.04;font-size:clamp(64px,6.1vw,96px);max-width:790px;margin-bottom:35px}
.about-journal .hero-c .c-hero-text>p{font-size:16px;color:#5c6b61;max-width:650px;margin-bottom:33px}
.about-journal .c-hero-visual{position:relative;padding:0 18px 50px 0}
.about-journal .c-hero-image{height:640px;overflow:hidden}
.about-journal .c-hero-image img{filter:saturate(.68)}
.about-journal .c-photo-mark{position:absolute;top:28px;right:-20px;background:#d5e9d8;border:8px solid #f5f1e8;border-radius:50%;width:110px;height:110px;display:grid;place-content:center;text-align:center;color:#237c64;font-size:28px;font-weight:800;line-height:1}
.about-journal .c-photo-mark span{font-size:11px;margin-top:6px}
.about-journal .c-photo-caption{position:absolute;right:0;bottom:0;background:#283f37;color:#fff;padding:25px 28px;font-size:11px;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:.13em;line-height:1.7}
.about-journal .c-proof{display:grid;grid-template-columns:165px repeat(4,1fr);border-top:1px solid #b5c5b7;gap:18px;margin-top:75px;padding-top:24px}
.about-journal .c-proof .eyebrow{padding-top:4px}
.about-journal .c-proof p{font-size:11px;line-height:1.6;font-weight:700}
.about-journal .c-proof p b{display:block;font-family:var(--serif);font-size:25px;font-weight:400;color:var(--teal);line-height:1;margin-bottom:8px}
.about-journal .thesis-c{background:var(--proto-editorial-sage);padding:125px 0}
.about-journal .c-thesis-head{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:30px;align-items:end;margin-bottom:60px}
.about-journal .c-side-label{font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.15em;line-height:1.7;text-align:right;font-weight:800;color:#789586}
.about-journal .c-casebook{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;column-gap:8%;row-gap:100px}
.about-journal .c-case{position:relative}
.about-journal .c-case:nth-child(even){transform:translateY(100px)}
.about-journal .c-case-photo{height:315px;position:relative}
.about-journal .c-case-photo img{filter:saturate(.7)}
.about-journal .c-case-photo span{position:absolute;top:17px;left:17px;background:#f7f5ee;padding:9px 12px;font-size:10px;font-weight:800;color:var(--teal)}
.about-journal .c-case-paper{position:relative;background:#fcfbf6;margin:-64px 0 0 12%;padding:28px 33px 33px;box-shadow:0 18px 45px rgba(22,52,38,.07)}
.about-journal .c-case-paper h3{font-family:var(--serif);font-size:36px;font-weight:400;margin:12px 0 23px}
.about-journal .c-case-line{display:grid;grid-template-columns:80px 1fr;gap:14px;border-top:1px solid #cbd9cc;padding:14px 0}
.about-journal .c-case-line b{font-size:10px;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.11em;color:var(--teal)}
.about-journal .c-case-line p{font-size:12px;color:#5d6d63}
.about-journal .pillars-c{padding:125px 0;background:var(--proto-editorial-paper)}
.about-journal .pillars-c .section-head{margin-bottom:48px}
.about-journal .c-backbone{display:grid;grid-template-columns:.87fr 1.13fr;gap:8%;align-items:start}
.about-journal .c-backbone-large{height:740px;position:sticky;top:20px}
.about-journal .c-backbone-large img{filter:saturate(.67)}
.about-journal .c-backbone-large>span{position:absolute;left:0;bottom:0;background:#d8e9d9;padding:18px 23px;font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.16em;font-weight:800}
.about-journal .c-backbone-text{border-top:1px solid #acbfb0}
.about-journal .c-backbone-text article{padding:35px 0 52px;border-bottom:1px solid #acbfb0;position:relative}
.about-journal .c-backbone-text article h3{font-family:var(--serif);font-size:42px;font-weight:400;letter-spacing:-.025em;margin:12px 0}
.about-journal .c-backbone-text article p{font-size:14px;color:#5d6f61;max-width:600px}
.about-journal .c-backbone-text .bullets{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;column-gap:22px}
.about-journal .c-backbone-text .bullets li{font-size:12px}
.about-journal .c-small-photo{height:185px;width:32%;position:absolute;right:0;bottom:28px;opacity:.36;z-index:0}
.about-journal .c-backbone-text article>*:not(.c-small-photo){position:relative;z-index:1}
.about-journal .portfolio-c{padding:125px 0;background:var(--proto-editorial-mint)}
.about-journal .portfolio-c .section-head{margin-bottom:42px}
.about-journal .chapter-tabs{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);border-bottom:1px solid #789688}
.about-journal .chapter-tab{border:0;background:transparent;text-align:left;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:16px;padding:18px 20px;color:#658275;border-bottom:4px solid transparent}
.about-journal .chapter-tab:first-child{padding-left:0}
.about-journal .chapter-tab.selected{color:#245f50;border-bottom-color:#245f50}
.about-journal .chapter-tab span{font-family:var(--serif);font-size:24px}
.about-journal .chapter-tab b{font-size:11px;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.12em}
.about-journal .chapter{display:none;grid-template-columns:58% 42%;background:#f6f4ed;min-height:600px}
.about-journal .chapter.selected{display:grid}
.about-journal .chapter-image{position:relative}
.about-journal .chapter-image img{filter:saturate(.72)}
.about-journal .chapter-image span{position:absolute;bottom:25px;left:25px;background:#fff;padding:12px 15px;color:#326b57;font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.13em;font-weight:800}
.about-journal .chapter-copy{padding:60px 8%;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:start}

.about-journal .chapter-copy p{font-size:14px;color:#5e7165}
.about-journal .chapter-copy small{display:block;font-size:11px;color:#76877d;line-height:1.5;margin-bottom:22px}
.about-journal .chapter-copy .button{margin-top:auto}
.about-journal .testimonials-c{padding:130px 0;background:var(--proto-editorial-paper)}
.about-journal .testimonials-c .section-head{margin-bottom:52px}
.about-journal .c-testimonial-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:9%}
.about-journal .c-quote:nth-child(2){padding-top:100px}
.about-journal .c-quote-image{height:340px;position:relative}
.about-journal .c-quote-image img{filter:saturate(.62)}
.about-journal .c-quote-image span{position:absolute;bottom:0;left:0;padding:14px 18px;background:var(--proto-editorial-paper);font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.12em;font-weight:800}
.about-journal .c-quote blockquote{font-family:var(--serif);font-size:clamp(26px,3vw,41px);line-height:1.24;letter-spacing:-.02em;padding:26px 0;border-bottom:1px solid #aebdae}
.about-journal .c-quote-person{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:20px;margin-top:15px;font-size:12px}
.about-journal .c-quote-person span{color:#698075;text-align:right;line-height:1.5}
.about-journal .faq-c{background:#23463e;color:#f0f7ee;padding:120px 0}

.about-journal .faq-c .section-head p{color:#bed2c6}
.about-journal .faq-c .eyebrow, .about-journal .faq-c .faq-no{color:#a5e3c2}
.about-journal .faq-c .faq-list{border-color:#759587}
.about-journal .faq-c .faq-list details{border-color:#759587}
.about-journal .faq-c .faq-answer p{color:#c9dbd0}

.about-journal .closing-c .narrative p{max-width:640px;font-size:17px;color:#577263;margin:0}
.about-journal .closing-c .panel{background:#fff;border:1px solid #d9d4c5;border-radius:var(--proto-radius-lg);padding:10px 22px}
.about-journal .closing-c .panel-title{font-size:10px;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:.17em;text-transform:uppercase;color:#8b8674;padding:14px 0 6px;margin:0}

.about-journal .closing-c .row .no{font-family:ui-monospace,SFMono-Regular,Menlo,monospace;font-size:11px;font-weight:700;color:var(--proto-teal-700)}
.about-journal .closing-c .row-body{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:2px;flex:1}
.about-journal .closing-c .row-body strong{font-size:14.5px;font-weight:700}
.about-journal .closing-c .row-body em{font-style:normal;font-size:12.5px;color:#8b8674}
.about-journal .closing-c .row .arrow{color:var(--proto-teal-700);font-weight:700;transition:transform .2s}
.about-journal .closing-c .row.primary .row-body strong{color:var(--proto-teal-700)}
.about-journal .closing-c .row:hover .arrow{transform:translateX(3px)}
